Jharkhand JSSC Exam Paper Leak: 10 Arrested, Nepal Link Uncovered

The Jharkhand CID has arrested one more successful candidate in the JSSC CGL paper leak case, bringing the total number of arrests to 10. The arrested individual had already been posted. Investigations have revealed a significant connection to Nepal, where it is alleged that question papers were taken to be memorized by candidates. Approximately 125 candidates are reportedly under surveillance in connection with the leak.
